summary: Tested the Deal Notes refinements (note-count badges, admin hide/unhide from lender view, new test_notes.py) end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: test_notes.py 14/14 PASS; wrote /app/backend/tests/test_notes_ui_followup.py (4/4 PASS) covering hide->lender-view filtering, unhide->note becomes visible to token lender + doc-counts, cleanup of UI-created notes, login-response shape, CORS preflight, and brute-force lockout (429 after 5 failures). Auth playbook: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$ for all 3 test accounts, lockout works. Frontend: found and fixed a CRITICAL white-screen crash in NotesPanel (`canModifyAsAdmin is not defined`) that broke the whole Client Portal; after the fix all three roles verified — admin post/hide/unhide + badge + persistence across reload, borrower sees admin's hidden note and has no hide toggle (post/edit/delete works), token-gated lender view never receives the hidden note (no badge, read-only panel, no hide toggle), and after unhide the note appears to the lender. Also fixed a duplicate data-testid collision on admin doc rows. All TEST_ui data deleted (0 remaining).

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins default '*' (CORS_ORIGINS unset) is an invalid combination — browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests. Low impact today because auth uses a Bearer token in the JSON body, but set explicit origins.

test_two_factor.py fails 14/40 in parallel ('module pytest has no attribute secret/wayne_token' + no 429 lockout) because state is stashed on the pytest module in one class and read in another class that loadscope assigns to the other worker. 40/40 pass with -n 0. test_deal_contacts.py::TestClientCrud::test_owning_client_crud also failed once in parallel (contacts list came back empty) — same non-atomic deal_contacts array read-modify-write race reported in iteration 16; passes serially. Neither is a notes regression, but the suites are not xdist-safe while pytest.ini forces -n 2.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER — dead line `const modifiable = canModify(n) || (state.editable && canModifyAsAdmin && ... && false)` referenced an undefined variable. Any viewer who is NOT the note author (e.g. borrower reading an admin note) hit `ReferenceError: canModifyAsAdmin is not defined` inside NotesPanel render, producing a full white-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay on /portal (Client Portal completely unusable). Removed the unused line; please confirm no logic was intended there.

FIXED BY TESTER — legacy client-facing note input used data-testid `doc-notes-<docId>`, colliding with the NotesPanel wrapper testid `doc-notes-<docId>` (strict-mode violation, 2 matching elements). Renamed the input to `doc-client-note-<docId>`.

Read-only lender panel button is labelled 'Add Note' when a doc has 0 notes, but lenders cannot add notes (composer is hidden, panel is readOnly). Label should be 'Notes' / 'View Notes' for the read-only variant.

The borrower also sees the amber 'HIDDEN' chip + gold row on notes the admin hid from lenders, with no explanation. From the borrower's perspective the note is NOT hidden, so the chip is confusing — either scope the chip to admins or label it 'Hidden from lender'.

issues: Deal Notes / Deal Contacts / doc cards render in a ~560px column with the entire right half of the viewport empty; the notes composer and doc rows feel cramped while huge whitespace sits beside them.

action_items: Review NotesPanel.jsx: the removed `modifiable` line was dead code referencing an undefined `canModifyAsAdmin` and crashed the Client Portal — confirm no admin-edit-others capability was intended (also remove the now-unused eslint-disable at NotesPanel.jsx:47).
Make test_two_factor.py xdist-safe (class/session-scoped fixtures instead of pytest.<attr> stashing) since pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope.
Make deal_contacts PATCH/DELETE atomic ($pull / arrayFilters) — still flaky in parallel (carry-over from iteration 16).
Relabel the read-only lender note button ('Add Note' -> 'Notes') and clarify/scope the 'HIDDEN' chip for borrowers.
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' with allow_credentials=True.
critical_code_review_comments: NotesPanel.jsx:139 shipped an undefined identifier inside the notes .map() — this is a render-time crash reachable by every borrower/lender viewing someone else's note; lint/eslint no-undef would have caught it (frontend build tolerates it, runtime does not).
Duplicate data-testid values on the same admin doc row make automated tests ambiguous; keep testids globally unique.

server.py notes routes look correct: visibility toggle is admin-gated (403 for client/lender), lender GET + doc-counts filter hidden_from_lenders, lender-view token routes require session_token (401 without) — verified by tests.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 test_notes.py + 4/4 followup; 2FA & deal-contacts failures are pre-existing xdist test-design/race issues)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of notes flows after the NotesPanel crash fix (0% for Client Portal before the fix)

rca_of_the_issue: Client Portal white screen: NotesPanel computed an unused `modifiable` flag whose right-hand operand referenced the never-declared `canModifyAsAdmin`. JS short-circuiting hid it for note authors (admin viewing own note), so admin testing passed, but any non-author render (borrower reading the admin note, lender reading any note) evaluated the identifier and threw a ReferenceError during render, unmounting the page tree. Removing the dead assignment restored all three portals; hide/unhide propagation to the token lender view then verified via API and UI.
